places.name: Papa la Șoni
places.evidence: Founder Alexandru Pădurean (Șoni) cooks the goulash himself; LIFE.ro and cluj.com feature interviews about his personal project born from cooking on the beach

places.name: Povestea Ceaunului
places.evidence: Family business run hands-on by owners Bogdan and Oana Boiță, who left their careers to take it over; profiled in Evenimentul Zilei and Capital

places.name: Căminul Cultural
places.evidence: Personal project of founders Adrian and Anda (also creators of Plaja de Carte); local press (Mangalia News) congratulates them by name for building the place

places.name: Molotov
places.evidence: Oreste Teodorescu's personal project built for family and close friends; interviews (Gândul, Business Magazin, Electronic Beats) confirm he spends every summer there as patron

places.name: La Canapele Rock
places.evidence: Owner-run local firm (Comitas SRL, since 1992); local press covers 'patronii localului' personally expanding their Vama Veche business

places.name: Bibi Bistro
places.evidence: Long-time personal project of co-founder Adrian Voican; recently handed to new owners Dan and Vlad who state they run it personally — current owner presence less documented
